title: Vietnamese-Style Roasted Potatoes
description: A French-inspired dish featuring roasted potatoes infused with the flavors of Vietnam, perfect as a side or light meal.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: any variety, peeled and cut into 1-inch wedges

ingredients.name: Banh
ingredients.notes: Vietnamese bread, available at most Asian markets

ingredients.name: Lovely Oil
ingredients.notes: or other neutral-tasting oil, such as canola or grapeseed

ingredients.name: Bot
ingredients.notes: Vietnamese coriander, available at most Asian markets

instructions: Toss the potatoes with the lovely oil, roasted garlic, bot, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
Crumble the banh and sprinkle over the potatoes.
Return to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes, or until the banh is lightly toasted.
